beats.text: Hiro stared at his neighbor's vintage guitar and wished intensely that it were hanging on his own wall.
beats.decisive_clue: wanted to own the neighbor’s specific guitar
beats.reason: The clue 'wanted to own the neighbor’s specific guitar' points to desire for another’s possession, not resentment of another’s good fortune.

beats.text: He admired the neighbor and spent evenings imagining himself playing that exact instrument.
beats.decisive_clue: admired the owner while longing for the object
beats.reason: The detail 'admired the owner while longing for the object' leaves desire for another’s possession as the better fit, not resentment of another’s good fortune.
